text:
Kaposi Sarcoma of the brain, central nervous system and intracranial glands is now collected in the following

- Brain: C700, C710-C719
- CNS Other: C701, C709, C720-C725, C728-C729
- Intracranial Gland: C751-C753
Summary Stage is the only applicable staging system for this site/histology/schema.
Code 0 is not applicable for this chapter.

SUMMARY STAGE 1 Localized only

- Single or multiple lesion(s)

Mucosa (e.g., oral cavity, anus, rectum, vagina, vulva)
Skin and/or connective tissue
Viscera (e.g., pulmonary, gastrointestinal tract, spleen, other)
